subject: SIG initiation & evidence ownership for Kitewell Health
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@kitewellhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG initiation & evidence ownership for Kitewell Health

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the asks we discussed so Kitewell can decide the questionnaire path:

- Required compliance: HIPAA (covered entity integration) and SOC 2 Type II (you mentioned SOC 2 is in progress).
- Preferred form: you indicated a preference for the SIG/CAIQ matrix, but you may want a small custom mapping for our VPC/private deployment model.
- Timeline: Kitewell is aiming for a security review within the next 3 weeks to unblock procurement.

Next actions we suggest from Redwood:
1) Confirm SIG vs CAIQ (we can prefill SIG answers where reasonable).
2) Identify evidence owners on your side (names + email) for 1) SOC 2 attestation items and 2) technical evidence (network diagrams, KMS screenshots).
3) Share any procurement/contract deadlines.

I've attached a lightweight SIG prefill template (redwood_sig_prefill_template.xlsx) and our SOC2 high-level summary (SOC2-summary-2025.pdf) so you can see what we can prefill vs what needs primary evidence.

Would you like us to start a prefill and mark items as "needs evidence" so your team only supplies the missing docs? If yes, please confirm the primary security contact and the procurement email to loop in.

Thanks — I can coordinate the initial prefill and schedule a short follow-up 30-minute call once we have the owners.

Best,
Irene Choi
Security & Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_sig_prefill_template.xlsx (excel; 48KB stub), SOC2-summary-2025.pdf (pdf; 210KB stub)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@kitewellhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@kitewellhealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & evidence ownership for Kitewell Health

Thanks, Irene — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming details from our side: 

- Compliance posture: HIPAA required for our integrations. SOC 2 Type II is currently in progress; target completion Q4 2026. We will likely accept SOC 2 in progress + mapped evidence where SIG items require it.
- Questionnaire preference: We prefer a SIG route because our vendor security team finds the matrix easier for internal sign-off, but we will need a short mapping for any items that reference enrollment in our specific compliance controls.
- Timeline: Procurement has a soft deadline of Sept 1 to complete vendor review, ideally earlier if possible.

Primary contacts: 
- Security: Me (Samira Khan) — samira.khan@kitewellhealth.com
- Procurement: procurement@kitewellhealth.com (cc'd) — primary contact is Jordan Lee (procurement@kitewellhealth.com).

We would welcome a prefill; please mark anything that requires primary evidence as "needs evidence" so we can prioritize. Also, can you confirm whether Redwood will accept screenshots for KMS key policies and a shared read-only diagram for the VPC network flow as evidence?

If you can start the prefill today that would be great. After you send the prefill we'll schedule a 30-minute sync (Samira + Jordan + Redwood) to walk through any gaps.

Best,
Samira
Head of Security Operations
Kitewell Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & evidence ownership for Kitewell Health

Hi Samira / Irene —

Quick internal note and a proposed approach from engineering/security at Redwood:

- Prefill plan: We will prefill standard SIG items (identity, asset inventory, patching cadence, third-party subprocessors) and flag anything requiring primary evidence. Typically that reduces the customer's upload burden by ~60-70%.
- Evidence we can accept: screenshots for KMS policies, exported IAM policy snippets, and read-only VPC diagrams are fine for initial review. For anything that requires audit-traceable artifacts (e.g., SOC 2 test results), we'll ask for the SOC 2 report or the SOC 2 management response — but for in-progress SOC2 we can accept the control matrix and timelines.
- Redwood SOC2 ETA: SOC 2 Type II audit is scheduled for Jan 2027; we can provide the 2025 summary in the meantime and a control map.

Irene — can your team start the prefill and mark evidence ownership columns like: "kitewell:owner@domain.com" vs "redwood:owner@redwoodinference.com"? Ben, please hold a short internal checklist (we'll attach to the prefill) for screenshots we can provide.

Samira — Jordan from procurement included in your cc: when you're ready we'll propose a 30-min slot.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & evidence ownership for Kitewell Health

Samira — thanks for the quick confirmation and the procurement contact. We're starting the prefill now. Summary of immediate next steps and owners: 

- Redwood will upload a prefilled SIG workbook by EOD today (redwood_sig_prefill_template.xlsx) and flag all items that need Kitewell evidence. Owner columns will be set to either "kitewell:email" or "redwood:email".
- Evidence accepted for initial review: KMS screenshots, exported IAM policy snippets, and a read-only VPC diagram (confirmed). Final attestations for some controls will require SOC 2 artifacts once available.
- Proposed follow-up: 30-min sync on Tue Aug 17 or Wed Aug 18 — please let us know Jordan's availability.

Ben will attach a short checklist of the screenshots we can produce to speed your team up. If anything in the prefill looks off, mark it and we'll triage immediately.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line before your procurement deadline.

Irene
Security & Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
